\section[vilāsaṁ]{\ml{വിലാസം} (vilāsaṁ) — address}

\label{lesson:ML-C126-address}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for uncle, then the Malayalam for a nephew.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{വിലാസം}}
\textbf{\ml{വിലാസം}} (\emph{vilāsaṁ}) — \textquotedblleft{}address\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{\ml{നിങ്ങളുടെ} \ml{വിലാസം} \ml{എന്താണ്}?} — \textquotedblleft{}what is your address?\textquotedblright{}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The name question, asked about a place.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vilāsaṁ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vilāsaṁ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} ask \emph{niṅṅaḷuṭe vilāsaṁ entāṇŭ?}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for uncle, then the Malayalam for a nephew, then say \emph{vilāsaṁ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{വിലാസം} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Address\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
